scope: Exact retained HvWE, Maxwell and controlled-time packaging bridge and its Pages invocation; separate from fresh NorSand qualification and full-package/browser/release results.
findings: The three listed retained engines are packaged by unchanged builders at the exact pinned predecessor commit after current source, retained engine and receipt pins, existing approvals and fresh generated bytes are checked. The same source comparison and regeneration are repeated after packaging. Existing qualification and package checker commands remain in the release path.

Independently regenerated current files for all three retained engines and ran the source checks against a minimal source tree reconstructed from exact Git blobs of the pinned predecessor. All three positive checks passed.
Negative controls rejected an unexpected compiled source edit, a new source file, a changed approved-source byte, a changed scoped test byte and a changed retained Wasm binary.

Only HvWE sees the extra exact test_formulation.py delta in its receipt closure. The test change adds checks that definitions containing postsolve predicates fail compilation through the ordinary compiler. It changes no generator inputs or model behavior and is pinned by exact before/after hashes.

The Pages workflow fetches the same reviewed predecessor SHA; the bridge checks the detached worktree identity before any retained packaging. Unknown source and artifact changes, guard failure, or absent review fail packaging.
limitations: Static review and pure Python controls; no full site package, Wasm calls, browser check or deployment was performed by this reviewer.
This accepts the exact implementation bytes only and does not transfer the old qualifications to any new compiled artifact or numerical scope.
